name: Isven Rosavelle de Lori
source:
King of Noril. Officially the king of the Arctic Ocrean Kingdom, but it's only in title. Truly, what Isven is the king of is deadpan snarking and appearing desperately to want to be anywhere else. Unfortunately, his choice to be distant has led him to, not being much loved by the Norillean people, who would prefer a much more approachable head of state. With the right revolutionary, Isven could be overthrown at a moment's notice.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=36495]Lemma Soft Forum[/url]]
